articles.title: Is Marvell Stock Priced Right Against Its Peers?
articles.description: Investors in Marvell Technology (MRVL) have seen the stock return 220.8% over the past twelve months, making it the top performer in a group of five chipmakers. That peer group includes NVIDIA, Broadcom, Advanced Micro Devices and Qualcomm. Yet the underlying financials reveal a different hierarchy, with the company ranking only fourth of the five on revenue growth, and fourth on operating margin. So how much are buyers now paying for Marvell's earnings, next to those peers.
